title: Estimating Worksheet — Building the Reinstatement Charge on a Building Automation Service Plan
content:
# Estimating Worksheet — Building the Reinstatement Charge on a Building Automation Service Plan

The reinstatement charge on a plan under the Building Automation Service Plans is built line by line from the figures below.

## Lines of the worksheet

| Line | What it carries |
|---|---|
| A — reinstatement fee | the tier's reinstatement fee |
| B — remote connection | a quarter of the tier's annual secure remote access gateway fee, that is 25 per cent of it, taken to re-commission the remote connection |
| C — database re-synchronisation | no controls technician time is charged for re-synchronising the controls database |
| D — back-filled readings | no charge is raised for back-filling the readings the site did not send while it stood unmonitored |
| E — site survey | no share of the tier's controls site survey fee is taken |
| Total | the sum of those amounts, rounded to two decimal places |

## The days and the months

The days the site has stood without monitoring are counted in calendar days from the day monitoring was withdrawn to the handling day, that day excluded and the handling day included. The whole months of the days charged for re-synchronisation are taken by counting thirty days to the month — 30 days to one month — and dropping any part month, and line C carries the controls technician time charged for each whole such month.

## How the lines act on one another

Each element is worked out on its own and the elements are then added together, none of them acting on another; and the rounding is carried out once, on the final sum, to two decimal places.

## Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

Take a plan whose tier carries a reinstatement fee of 350 USD and an annual secure remote access gateway fee of 480 USD, at a site whose monitoring was withdrawn 74 days before the handling day, counting the day of withdrawal out and the handling day in.

- Line A is 350.00 USD.
- Line B is a quarter of 480 USD, that is 120.00 USD.
- The days charged for re-synchronisation are those 74 days, which at thirty days to the month give 2 whole months, the part month being dropped; line C carries no controls technician time, so it is nil for each of those months.
- Lines D and E are nil.
- The reinstatement charge is 350.00 USD plus 120.00 USD, that is 470.00 USD.
